{{Quote|My friend was killed during the mutiny.''"<br />"''Oh dear. I'm sorry to hear that. I take it you were in love?''"<br />"''We were.|Lydea Pagorski and Eramuth Bwua'tu|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex" />}}
'''Liyn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] at the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Second Battle of Fondor]], Liyn served as a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] with the [[Bloodfin Security|security forces]] aboard the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Turbulent-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']]. He [[Death/Legends|died]] when the ship's crew mutinied against the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], who decided to side with [[Darth Caedus]] after [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon's]] death.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex" />

[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lydea Pagorski]] would later claim that she and Liyn were in love, and that Liyn confided in her that former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahiri Veila]] was among the individuals who attended the conference aboard the ''Bloodfin'', shortly before the battle at Fondor.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex" />
